purpose: Contain a focused blocking form, preview or confirmation while preserving the invoker.

close.description: Requests close with an explicit reason.

accessibility.keyboard: Tab and Shift+Tab remain inside the topmost dialog; Escape is consumed by only the topmost CRM modal and requests close only when dismissible.
accessibility.focus: Opening focuses requested/first control; closing restores the exact invoker.
accessibility.screenReader: Title and optional description label the dialog.

motion.reducedMotion: Immediate final state with focus preserved.

invariants: A non-dismissible critical confirmation has an explicit cancel route in its content.
Inline callback and state updates do not restart the focus trap or replace the recorded invoker.
Closing the topmost modal restores the exact connected element that invoked it.
